description: Look up a trader by the opaque masked id (tid) returned in leaderboard / pulse / movers / top-ROI rows — those masked surfaces omit the raw wallet, so use the tid to follow a trader. Returns the same masked skill teaser as the wallet lookup. Full wallet/identity resolution requires signing in on polyrank.app.

tid.description: Opaque trader id (tid) from a masked row.

name: polyrank_get_trader_by_tid
title: Polyrank trader teaser (by masked id)
